video_title: Post Game Media Availability | Preseason | October 12, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the team's opportunity for young players
quotes.excerpt: all nine of us just sees the opportunity. You don't get that opportunity too much
quotes.quote: all nine of us just sees the opportunity. You don't get that opportunity too much, so we took it and ran with it and proud of the guys. We fought to the very end. Obviously not the result we wanted, but proud of the fight.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on the Thunder young core taking advantage of preseason minutes: We all see the opportunity. You don't get that opportunity too much, so we took it and ran with it and proud of the guys.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on developing chemistry with Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: he's a great screener and roller and obviously he's a threat because he's 7'4
quotes.quote: the first half was a little rough, we're still getting used to it. The second half we kind of let it click, couple of lobs here and there and he's a great screener and roller and obviously he's a threat because he's 7'4, so it's pretty easy to throw the ball up to him. I just got to get more reps just playing with him, because any point guard is a deadly combo with the die. He's so special in that way, so we got to get it clicking.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on building chemistry with Chet Holmgren: He is a great screener and roller and obviously he is a threat because he is 7'4, so it is pretty easy to throw the ball up to him.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his late-game shot selection
quotes.excerpt: that gave us the best shot to try and win the game
quotes.quote: the shot felt good. I think that gave us the best shot to try and win the game and that's what they were giving me, so the paint was collapsing and people were in there and the three-point shot was there, so confidence and just shot that thing.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on his late game shot selection: The paint was collapsing and people were in there and the three point shot was there, so confidence and just shot that thing.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on building chemistry with Josh Giddey
quotes.excerpt: he's a great dude off the court, fun to hang out with
quotes.quote: he's a great dude off the court, fun to hang out with. My locker is right next to him, so we've gotten pretty close and yeah, he's playing really confident out there and he's letting that thing fly and it's really fun to play out there with him, just knowing that he's always there and ready to knock down a shot, so I'm looking forward to the season with him.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on his growing chemistry with Josh Giddey: He is playing really confident out there and he is letting that thing fly and it is really fun to play out there with him.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on correcting early game breakdowns
quotes.excerpt: we had some breakdowns early that you'd like to be able to fix in game
quotes.quote: we had some breakdowns early that you'd like to be able to fix in game rather than the next day, which we did. And then the guys obviously, to your point, played a clutch time game that we can learn from. So I thought the guys gave a good effort, had a great approach and we got a lot out of it collectively.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the Thunder preseason effort: We had some breakdowns early that you would like to be able to fix in game rather than the next day, which we did. I thought the guys gave a good effort.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Ousmane Dieng's development and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: he's done such a good job of handling his business on those priorities
quotes.quote: Ousmane obviously has the capacity to do that, but that hasn't been the foundational priority for his development so far. But he's done such a good job of handling his business on those priorities that tonight I thought afforded an opportunity for us to play through that a little bit and just establish kind of a baseline of where that skill is. And obviously he did really good things, he had some plays he could get back, but it gave us an understanding of where he is walking in the door on something that may not be like a featured priority right off the bat.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Ousmane Dieng playing through playmaking duties: It gave us an understanding of where he is walking in the door on something that may not be like a featured priority right off the bat.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace's composure in pressure situations
quotes.excerpt: he's got great moxie and clearly is used to being with the ball in his hands
quotes.quote: he's got great moxie and clearly is used to being with the ball in his hands in pressure situations, shooting big shots, having to make big plays. It's been a feature of his career to this point and so a lot of the things he's learning are new for him, but that's not new for him. So he's clearly comfortable in those situations.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace: He has got great moxie and clearly is used to being with the ball in his hands in pressure situations, shooting big shots, having to make big plays.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the importance of confidence for young players
quotes.excerpt: you're going to miss shots, you're going to lose games, you're going to get knocked down
quotes.quote: in the NBA you're going to miss shots, you're going to lose games, you're going to get knocked down. You got to have the resolve and the confidence to shoot the next one with confidence and get back up and it's not smooth sailing for anybody in the NBA, so you want guys that can lean into the competition with confidence and that was a big shot for him.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the importance of confidence for young players: In the NBA you are going to miss shots, you are going to lose games, you are going to get knocked down. You got to have the resolve and the confidence to shoot the next one.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace's offensive and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: he's an excellent floor spacer, he's always in the right spots
quotes.quote: the functionality for him is both ends. He can step into shots and make them obviously, he makes sound decisions with the ball, he's an excellent floor spacer, he's always in the right spots and then on the other end of the floor, he's always in the right spots and he can guard a range of matchups and so he's made a really good first impression in terms of his reliability and he's just a player that you don't get beat on possessions when he's in the game.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace: He has made a really good first impression in terms of his reliability and he is just a player that you do not get beat on possessions when he is in the game.
